g.aria-label: FSDP Block Prefetching: Host-Staged PCIe vs. NVLink 5
(a) PCIe 4.0 via Host DRAM (2.2 GB/s): Link-Bound (g ≫ c)
1.92B GPT (1.5 S = 11.5 GB): Comm L·g ≈ 5.0 s vs. Compute L·c ≈ 0.40 s
GPU 0 spends > 90% of the 5.5 s step waiting on NCCL collectives!
(b) NVLink 5 (900 GB/s) + Next-Block Prefetching: Compute-Bound (g ≤ c)
Comm Stream: [AG Blk 1][AG Blk 2][AG Blk 3] (11.5 GB takes only ~13 ms!)
Comp Stream: [Comp Blk 1][Comp Blk 2] → Forward = g + (L−1)max(g,c) + c
